summary: Validated visual bug fix on Autodeclaração de raça field (select#atr2335) for both public forms pmsp2601.html and pmsp2602.html. On initial page load with no interaction: (a) wrapper .form-group does NOT contain 'has-error' class, (b) select has no aria-invalid/aria-describedby attributes, (c) no #atr2335-error element exists in DOM, (d) 'Informação obrigatória' text does not appear under the field. Screenshots confirm neutral visual state (no red border, no red label). Other page elements intact: titles correct (pmsp2601='Aluno-Soldado PM do Quadro de Praças (QP)', pmsp2602 title contains 'Cadete PM'), fieldset order preserved (Inscrição → Identificação → Declaração), SALVAR button visible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Visual bug fix verificado com sucesso via DOM inspection em ambas as páginas públicas estáticas.
